description: Oklahoma-only rules checked against the cited statutes and Service Oklahoma pages. National rules stay in the baseline. No fines.

questions.q: On a properly marked Oklahoma school zone on a highway outside a municipality, the speed is
questions.explanation: 47 O.S. section 11-801 sets twenty-five miles per hour on any highway outside a municipality in a properly marked school zone, during certain times as provided in Section 11-806.1, if the zone is marked with warning signs under the Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices. The Department of Transportation may determine that a higher speed is reasonable and safe and post an alternative school-zone speed.

questions.q: An Oklahoma school bus is limited to
questions.explanation: 47 O.S. section 11-801 sets a school bus at fifty-five miles per hour on paved two-lane roads, except on the state highway system, the interstate highway system, and the turnpike system, where the maximum shall be sixty-five miles per hour.

questions.q: Unless the board of county commissioners posts otherwise, an Oklahoma county-road speed is
questions.explanation: 47 O.S. section 11-801 says no person shall drive on a county road at a speed in excess of fifty-five miles per hour unless posted otherwise by the board of county commissioners.

questions.q: A 75 mph speed on a rural Oklahoma interstate
options: is the automatic limit on every rural interstate
may be set after a study shows it is safe
questions.explanation: 47 O.S. section 11-801 says a speed limit of seventy-five miles per hour may be set on rural segments of the interstate highway system by the Transportation Commission, provided the speed is determined to be safe and reasonable after a traffic or engineering study by the Department. It is not an automatic statewide interstate speed.

questions.q: The Oklahoma DUI statute in effect in October 2026 treats a blood or breath alcohol concentration of 0.08 or more as
options: legal if the driver is not weaving
unlawful at the time of a test of the person's blood or breath
unlawful only if the test is taken within three hours
questions.explanation: The version of 47 O.S. section 11-902 amended by Laws 2026, SB 1627, chapter 12, section 67, effective April 13, 2026, is the text in effect before the separate November 1, 2026 amendment. It makes it unlawful to drive with a blood or breath alcohol concentration of eight-hundredths (0.08) or more at the time of a test of the person's blood or breath. That current text also separately prohibits driving under the influence of alcohol.

questions.q: Oklahoma also makes it unlawful to drive if the person
questions.explanation: The April 13, 2026 text of 47 O.S. section 11-902 lists, as separate unlawful grounds, a blood or breath alcohol concentration of 0.08 or more at the time of the test and being under the influence of alcohol.

questions.q: For an Oklahoma driver under 21, the alcohol rule that was opened is
options: 0.08, the same as an adult, with no lower rule
any measurable alcohol, tested within two hours
0.04 if the car is privately owned
questions.explanation: 47 O.S. section 11-906.4 makes it unlawful for a person under twenty-one to drive, operate, or be in actual physical control of a motor vehicle who has any measurable quantity of alcohol in the blood or breath at the time of a test administered within two hours after arrest. A commercial 0.04 number was not in the sections opened for this file.

questions.q: Oklahoma suspends a license when the point total reaches
questions.explanation: Service Oklahoma's violations page says points are assessed for convictions of certain violations, generally traffic violations, and that when the point total reaches ten or more points within a five-year period the license is suspended.

questions.q: If an Oklahoma driver goes 12 consecutive months with no pointable conviction,
questions.explanation: Service Oklahoma says that if a driver goes twelve consecutive months without a conviction of any pointable violation, two points are removed. If the driver goes three consecutive years without a pointable conviction, the point level is reduced to zero.

questions.q: An approved Oklahoma driver-improvement or defensive-driving course
options: adds 2 points to the driving record
questions.explanation: Service Oklahoma says two points will be deducted upon successful completion of an approved driver-improvement or defensive-driving course, and that two-point reduction is given only one time in a 24-month period.

questions.q: Before the Oklahoma intermediate drive test, behind-the-wheel training must be at least
options: 100 hours if the driver is under 16
questions.explanation: Service Oklahoma's intermediate-license page requires at least 50 hours, 10 at night, of behind-the-wheel training from a licensed driver at least 21 who has been licensed at least 2 years. Proof may be the Affidavit of Driver Training.

questions.q: An Oklahoma intermediate licensee may normally drive from 5:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. and may carry
options: 1 passenger, or any with a driver 21+
questions.explanation: Service Oklahoma's intermediate-license page says driving is from 5:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m., with no time restriction if the trip is to or from school, church, or work, or if a licensed driver at least 21 sits in the front seat. Passenger limits are 1 passenger, or only household members, or any passenger if a licensed driver at least 21 is in the front seat.

questions.q: In Oklahoma, what is the youngest age at which you can get a learner's permit for a car?
questions.explanation: Oklahoma issues a learner's permit for a car at 15 years at the earliest.

questions.q: In Oklahoma, how long must a driver under 18 hold a learner's permit before moving to the next license?
questions.explanation: Oklahoma requires drivers under 18 to hold the learner's permit for 6 months.

questions.q: How many hours of supervised driving must a teen in Oklahoma complete before getting a provisional license?
questions.explanation: Oklahoma requires 50 hours of supervised driving before the provisional license.

questions.q: Of a Oklahoma teen's required supervised driving hours, how many must be at night?
questions.explanation: Oklahoma requires at least 10 hours of the supervised driving to be at night.

questions.q: In Oklahoma, what is the youngest age at which a teen can get a license to drive without a supervisor?
questions.explanation: In Oklahoma, the earliest unsupervised (provisional) license is at 16 years.

questions.q: During which hours may a newly licensed teen in Oklahoma not drive without a supervisor?
questions.explanation: Oklahoma restricts provisional drivers from 10 p.m. to 5 a.m., with exceptions such as work or school.

questions.q: How many questions are on the Oklahoma car knowledge test?
questions.explanation: The Oklahoma car knowledge test has 20 questions.

provenance.manual: Apply for a Learner Permit - Oklahoma.gov

questions.q: In Oklahoma, a driver 21 or older is legally impaired at what blood alcohol concentration?
questions.explanation: In Oklahoma, drivers 21 and older are over the limit at 0.08% or more.

questions.q: In Oklahoma, a driver under 21 breaks the law at what blood alcohol concentration?
questions.explanation: Oklahoma sets the under-21 limit at 0.00%.

questions.q: What is the highest standard speed limit for cars on rural interstates in Oklahoma?
questions.explanation: Rural interstates in Oklahoma can be posted up to 75 mph for cars.

provenance.manual: A drive up to 75; speed limit changes in sight for some rural Oklahoma interstates - Oklahoma.gov

questions.q: Which best describes Oklahoma's law on drivers using a phone?
options: Phone use is banned only for new or young drivers
No statewide ban on phone use or texting
Only texting is banned for all drivers
Hand-held phone use is banned for all drivers
questions.explanation: Oklahoma: only texting is banned for all drivers.

questions.q: When is a left turn on a red light allowed in Oklahoma?
options: Only from a one-way street onto a one-way street
From a one-way or two-way street onto a one-way street
questions.explanation: In Oklahoma, a left turn on red (after a full stop, where not prohibited) is allowed: only from a one-way street onto a one-way street.

questions.q: How is Oklahoma's seat belt law for adults enforced?
options: Primary: police can stop you just for not wearing a seat belt
No seat belt law for adults
Secondary: police can cite you only after stopping you for something else
questions.explanation: Oklahoma seat belt enforcement is primary.

questions.q: Until what age must a child ride in a car seat or booster seat in Oklahoma?
questions.explanation: Oklahoma requires a car seat or booster until 8 years, with height or weight exceptions.

questions.q: Under Oklahoma's point system, what is the lowest point total that can suspend an adult's license?
questions.explanation: Oklahoma can suspend an adult's license at 10 points in 60 months.
